newsitem.title: USA: Hurco Q1 Jan 31 net up on lower expenses.
newsitem.headline: Hurco Q1 Jan 31 net up on lower expenses.

text.p: Hurco Cos Inc said Thursday lower interest expense as a result of reduced debt levels helped net earnings nearly double in the first quarter.
Net income reached $1.0 million, or $0.15 a share, up from $572,000, or $0.10 a share, one year ago, the company said. Average shares outstanding were 6.7 million versus 5.6 million.
Hurco said interest expense in the period ended January 31 fell to $522,000 from $1.1 million in 1996.
Sales totaled $22.3 million compared to $23.2 million in the corresponding period last year.
Hurco produces computer numerical controls systems for stand-alone machine tools.
Its shares were unchanged Thursday at 6.
